candidates.why_relevant: Largest Kosovo job board; carries bank vacancies from NLB Banka, TEB, ProCredit, Banka per Biznes, FINCA, NBT. Job URLs are company-slug based (kosovajob.com/<company>/<job-slug>) plus legacy numeric /jobs?id=NNNN, so a per-employer crawl gives a clean per-bank vacancy stream. New role titles (ESG Corporate Officer, digital banking, cards) are direct weak signals of new units/systems.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Polite scheduled HTML crawl of company pages (e.g. /nlb-banka, /teb-banka, /procredit-bank) + search results; diff vacancy titles over time; archive full ad text before expiry since listings are removed after deadline.
queries_used: kosovajob.com konkurs bankë vende pune Prishtinë
ofertapune.net konkurs bankë sistemet e pagesave zyrtar

candidates.why_relevant: Sister property of the KosovaJob network with its own /konkursi/<slug> permalinks. Carries banking and collections/call-centre roles (e.g. 'Mbikeqyres/e i/e Ri/e Bankar/e', 'Zyrtar/e per Thirrje ne Kolektime'). Because it is a separate render of overlapping inventory it is a useful redundancy/deduplication partner when KosovaJob blocks or expires an ad.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /konkursi/ permalinks; dedupe against KosovaJob by employer+title+deadline.
queries_used: punaime.org duapune.com shpalljepune.com konkurs bankë Kosovë

candidates.why_relevant: Second-tier but high-volume Kosovo board; its Facebook page shows it routinely posts bank konkurse (ProCredit Bank etc.) with links of form portalpune.com/jobs/<numeric-id>, and it exposes tag pages such as /jobs/tag/Vende-pune-ne-Kosove. Numeric IDs make incremental ID-walking collection cheap.
candidates.access_status: bot-defended (HTTP 403 on plain fetch) - unverified, likely live
candidates.legal_status: public listings; 403 suggests active anti-bot posture, respect it
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless browser with realistic UA/headers, low rate; or harvest links from its Facebook page as an index and fetch only the linked job IDs.
queries_used: portalpune.com vende pune bankë menaxher Kosovë
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch of https://portalpune.com/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no body; site is clearly live per indexed tag pages and active Facebook posting.

candidates.why_relevant: Major Kosovo board carrying bank roles (TEB Banka 'Analist i Zgjidhjeve te Biznesit', treasury, credit/collections). Exposes job-tag taxonomy (/job-tag/<tag>) which lets you subscribe to a role-family rather than an employer - ideal for tracking, e.g., payments/cards/collections role families across all banks. Also carries a calls/grants/tenders section, an adjacent org-change signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /jobs/<slug> and enumerate /job-tag/ taxonomy; also monitor /skadon (expiring) to capture ads before deletion.
queries_used: ofertapune.net konkurs bankë sistemet e pagesave zyrtar

candidates.why_relevant: Forum-style Albanian-language classifieds covering both Albania and Kosovo. Carries strikingly specific bank ads - 'Specialist/Senior Specialist - Departamenti i Kartave dhe Pagesave' and 'Specialist ne Njesine e Digjitalizimit dhe Kanaleve Alternative te Shperndarjes' - i.e. explicit cards/payments and digital-channel unit names. Thread IDs are sequential (/threads/<slug>.<id>/), and forum threads are rarely deleted, so it doubles as an archive of expired ads that boards purge.
candidates.legal_status: public forum; user-posted content, verify employer authenticity
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the jobs subforum by thread id; filter on bank/PSP names and payments keywords. Tag XK vs AL because the site mixes both markets.
queries_used: njoftime.com punë bankare Kosovë specialist i pajtueshmërisë konkurs

candidates.why_relevant: Aggregator of active konkurse in Kosovo. Aggregators are valuable because they normalise employer names across boards and often surface small PSP/microfinance employers that the two big boards under-index.
candidates.legal_status: aggregated public listings; may republish other boards' content
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Light crawl; primarily use as a discovery feed for employers not seen on KosovaJob/OfertaPune, then follow through to the original board.
queries_used: kosovajob.com konkurs bankë vende pune Prishtinë
punaime.org duapune.com shpalljepune.com konkurs bankë Kosovë

candidates.why_relevant: Kosovo job portal with a company-directory structure (/companies/<id>/detajet), which is unusually useful: it gives a per-employer landing page and therefore a stable per-bank vacancy history URL. Also indexes public institutions (e.g. APRK), useful for regulator-side hiring.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve each Kosovo bank/PSP to its /companies/<id>/detajet page, then poll those pages.
queries_used: "konkursi.net" OR "kastori.net" OR "gjejpune.org" OR "gjirafa.com/top/pune" portal konkurse pune Kosovë bankë

candidates.why_relevant: Gjirafa is the dominant Albanian-language search/portal group in Kosovo; its jobs vertical aggregates vacancies across Kosovo and Albania. High crawl reach and good for catching ads posted only on employer sites that Gjirafa's crawler picked up.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword queries on the vertical (bankë, pagesa, kartela, kredi, pajtueshmëri) and follow outbound links to original postings.

candidates.why_relevant: Posts each konkurs with a timestamp and a deep link back to the job page. That timestamp is often the only reliable publication date once the underlying ad expires, and the feed is a low-cost change-detector that avoids crawling the board itself. Observed posting ProCredit Bank vacancies including Mitrovica e Veriut.
candidates.access_status: public page; Facebook applies login walls and rate limits to automated access

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest outbound job IDs and post/deadline dates; use IDs to fetch the underlying listing via headless browser.

candidates.source_name: Agjencia e Punesimit e Republikes se Kosoves (APRK) jobseeker portal
candidates.why_relevant: State employment agency portal; employers including financial institutions register vacancies here, and since 2023-ish jobseeker registration moved online. Government-run so it is the most credible vacancy record, and its structured vacancy data is a useful cross-check on private boards. Service layer appears to sit at aprk.appdec.com.
candidates.access_status: public front-end; vacancy search may require registration - unverified
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Probe the public vacancy search; if gated, use for periodic manual verification and for aggregate labour-market context rather than continuous collection.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles category inference (who must publish) + sq search

Relevant to this cell as the channel for regulator/state-financial-body hiring (ministry of finance, treasury, state-owned entities) - i.e. the public-sector mirror of bank org change. Not where commercial banks advertise.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-filtered periodic poll on finance/payments/treasury/supervision terms.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles (who is legally obliged to publish vacancies)

negative_findings.description: Neither kosovajob.com nor ofertapune.net exposes an RSS/Atom feed in its page markup, and no public API was found for either. KosovaJob additionally has no stable industry-category URL for banking - it uses company-slug pages and a search box filtering 'sipas Pozites, Qytetit, ose Industrise' whose category endpoints are not exposed in the HTML.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection must be HTML crawl + diff, not feed subscription; per-employer crawling is the only reliable banking slice on KosovaJob.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rules out the cheapest collection design and raises the fragility of the whole cell to site redesigns; also means listing publication dates must be inferred (e.g. from the boards' Facebook post timestamps).

negative_findings.description: portalpune.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no body on direct fetch, while its tag pages are search-indexed and its Facebook page posts fresh job links daily. This is bot defence, not a dead site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as blocked/unverified, not dead; Facebook feed identified as the workaround index.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive liveness pass would drop a high-volume bank-vacancy source. The 403 must be treated as a hypothesis pending a headless-browser retry.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Serbian for Kosovo bank vacancies ('konkurs za posao banka Kosovo Mitrovica oglasi posao srpski jezik'). No Kosovo-specific Serbian-language job board was found - only Serbia-wide boards (Infostud, HelloWorld, Poslovi.rs, KlikDoPosla) that carry a thin Kosovska Mitrovica location page. None of those pages surfaced an actual bank vacancy in the results reviewed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo banking vacancies exists only as a thin location filter on Serbia-wide boards.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hiring by Serbian-system financial institutions in northern Kosovo may be effectively invisible to this cell; the sr dimension cannot be assumed covered just because sr boards were catalogued.

negative_findings.description: Albanian job vocabulary does not distinguish Kosovo from Albania. njoftime.com and gjirafa jobs mix XK and AL listings, and the sharpest payments-role hit found ('Specialist - Departamenti i Kartave dhe Pagesave') is a Tirana vacancy. 'Bankë', 'konkurs', 'vende pune' are all high-noise on their own.
negative_findings.result_summary: Every sq query needs an XK disambiguator (city names: Prishtinë, Prizren, Pejë, Ferizaj, Gjakovë, Mitrovicë, Podujevë) or an XK-registered employer name.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without geo-disambiguation the cell will silently import Albanian market signals into Kosovo org-change conclusions.

negative_findings.description: No job board in this cell was found to publish executive appointments, board changes, or departures. Boards carry vacancies only; senior roles (Head of Digital Banking, CIO, Chief Compliance Officer) were not observed advertised on the sq boards reviewed - such hires appear to be executive-search or internal.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'leadership moves' topic is largely NOT served by this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move signal must come from another cell (press releases, BQK licensing/fit-and-proper notices, LinkedIn, media). Over-relying on job boards would under-detect C-level change.

negative_findings.description: Kosovo boards remove listings after the application deadline ('skadon' / 'mbyllet sot'); no public archive of expired bank ads was found on kosovajob.com, ofertapune.net or portalpune.com.
negative_findings.result_summary: Historical vacancy series cannot be reconstructed retroactively from these boards.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The org-change signal is only available going forward, and only if the collector snapshots full ad text at discovery time. njoftime.com forum threads are the one partial exception since threads persist.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo bank/PSP hiring is effectively absent - no Kosovo-specific sr board exists and Serbia-wide boards show only thin Kosovska Mitrovica pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test whether northern-Kosovo financial employers advertise via Serbian municipal/community channels, Facebook groups for Kosovska Mitrovica, or the Serbia-wide boards' employer pages; if not, formally mark the sr hiring dimension as uncovered rather than assumed covered.

coverage_gaps.description: Leadership moves and executive departures are not carried by any board in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route the 'leadership moves' topic to regulator (BQK fit-and-proper / licensing), company press-release and business-media cells; treat this cell's output as unit/system change only.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell covers third-party boards only. Bank and PSP first-party career pages (e.g. procreditbank-kos.com, bkt-ks.com, teb-kos.com, nlb-kos.com, raiffeisen-kosovo.com, bpbbank.com, bankaekonomike.com, ziraatbank.com.tr KS, Paysera Kosove) were identified as existing employers but their own /karriera pages were not enumerated here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a companion sub-cell that enumerates each licensed bank/PSP career page and its ATS (Workday/SmartRecruiters/etc.), since senior and technical roles often appear there first and never reach the boards.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank PSPs, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions (the fastest-changing organizations in payments) are under-represented in what the boards surfaced; only FINCA, Capital and a few appeared. The BQK register of licensed non-bank payment service providers was not cross-walked against board employer directories.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the BQK list of licensed banks, MFIs and non-bank PSPs and resolve each to its employer page on kosovajob.com/kastori.net; treat any licensed entity with no board presence as a first-party-only recruiter.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical archive of expired Kosovo bank vacancies was found, so no baseline exists before collection starts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin snapshotting full ad text immediately; probe the Wayback Machine for kosovajob.com/ofertapune.net employer pages to back-fill a partial baseline, and mine njoftime.com's persistent threads for older bank ads.

coverage_gaps.description: portalpune.com's 403 was not resolved, and aprk.rks-gov.net's vacancy search may be behind registration. duapune.com, gjejpune.org and shpalljepune.com were catalogued from search metadata without a depth probe.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser retry pass over these five domains before assigning final access_status; do not let the deterministic liveness pass mark portalpune.com dead on the 403 alone.

brief: Kosovo's Albanian-language job-board layer is concentrated and highly collectible: KosovaJob (with its sister property PunaIme), OfertaPune.net and Portal Pune carry the great majority of bank and PSP vacancies, with njoftime.com, Kastori, Gjirafa jobs, ShpalljePune, DuaPune and GjejPune as tail and redundancy sources, plus a government layer at APRK and konkursi.rks-gov.net. None of the boards expose an RSS feed or API, so collection must be per-employer HTML crawl-and-diff with immediate full-text snapshotting, because listings are purged at deadline and no public archive exists; portalpune.com additionally returns 403 to plain fetches and is best indexed via its Facebook feed, which also supplies the publication timestamps the boards themselves omit. The signal quality is good where it exists - observed ads name concrete new units such as 'Departamenti i Kartave dhe Pagesave', 'Njesia e Digjitalizimit dhe Kanaleve Alternative te Shperndarjes' and ESG corporate roles - but sq vocabulary does not separate Kosovo from Albania, so every query needs a city or employer disambiguator. Two structural limits should be pushed to other cells: these boards carry no leadership or board-level moves at all, and Serbian-language coverage of northern Kosovo financial hiring is close to non-existent, surviving only as thin Kosovska Mitrovica location pages on Serbia-wide boards.
